description: This file defines the RestXmlSerializer class, which extends the RestSerializer class to serialize AWS API structures into XML format. It includes methods for constructing the XML payload and customizing the XML body content.

classes.name: RestXmlSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class for converting AWS API structures into XML payloads, extending RestSerializer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with the AWS service API description, endpoint, and optional XML formatter.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Prepares the HTTP headers and body for the request with XML content.

methods.name: getXmlBody
methods.description: Generates and sanitizes the XML body content from the given structure and value.
